title: Bunny holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62,44 Q68,58 60,68' fill='none' stroke='#cfd8ff' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='28' rx='15' ry='17' fill='#ff5f8f'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='21' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#ff9fb8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M64,45 l-3,5 l6,0 z' fill='#d63a68'/>
  <!-- bunny body -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='74' rx='18' ry='18' fill='#e8e3f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='80' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#fbf9ff'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='90' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#d6cfe6'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='90' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#d6cfe6'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='30' rx='6' ry='18' fill='#e8e3f0' transform='rotate(-10 32 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='31' rx='2.6' ry='12' fill='#ffb6cf' transform='rotate(-10 32 31)'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='28' rx='6' ry='18' fill='#e8e3f0' transform='rotate(12 48 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='29' rx='2.6' ry='12' fill='#ffb6cf' transform='rotate(12 48 29)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='54' r='15' fill='#f4f0fa'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='52' r='2.4' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='52' r='2.4' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
  <circle cx='33.2' cy='51.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='45.2' cy='51.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose and mouth -->
  <path d='M40,56 l-2,2 l4,0 z' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <path d='M40,59 Q37,62 35,59' fill='none' stroke='#c9bfda' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M40,59 Q43,62 45,59' fill='none' stroke='#c9bfda' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='58' r='2.6' fill='#ffc2d6' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='58' r='2.6' fill='#ffc2d6' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- arm to balloon -->
  <path d='M52,64 Q58,60 61,52' fill='none' stroke='#e8e3f0' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
